changes.rationale: Root human help now names only canonical --json, exact human and versioned JSON golden assertions fail on any byte-level drift, and neither golden contains --format.

The clap builder consumes requiredness and ValueKind directly from OptionSpec. Introspection and executable behavior tests now cover every option's requiredness, kind, arity, and singleton multiplicity. Manual post-parse requiredness was removed; clap MissingRequiredArgument maps to MissingRequiredOption.
Dedicated off-by-one tests cover all four bounded dimensions, and malformed inputs use an explicit case-to-ParseErrorId oracle rather than treating every generated combination as necessarily invalid.
Clap diagnostics are classified from ErrorKind and bounded context only. Raw clap messages and untrusted argv are never returned, preserving ANSI-free non-echo human and JSON failures.

The candidate uses clap's builder API and no derive macro or suggestion rendering. Root should retain only error-context, help, std, and usage features while this implementation shape remains authoritative.
This module parses and describes only. It constructs no LiveContext, dispatches no command, reads no repository or environment state, emits no telemetry, and makes no behavior or readiness decision.
